finding_text: Administrative accounts used to access internal servers are protected only by usernames and passwords. Multi-factor authentication (MFA) is not enforced for privileged users.
Several user accounts belonging to former employees remain active in the Active Directory.
The organization has no evidence that annual information security awareness training is mandatory for all employees.
Multiple workstations are running unsupported versions of Windows.
The current password policy allows passwords as short as six characters without complexity requirements.
Backups are performed daily, but restoration tests are not documented or periodically executed.
Loss or theft of removable media could expose confidential customer information.
